caption: A garden hose sprays a fine mist with the sun behind it, and a small rainbow appears in the spray.

sa.check: A garden hose sprays a mist.
A rainbow appears in the spray.

pc.expect: The rainbow appears within the mist while the spray runs and is not on the ground or in dry air.
pc.fail: It is on the ground; or in dry air beside the spray; or the spray runs in sunlight with no rainbow.

pc.expect: The rainbow exists only with the mist and would vanish when the water is turned off.
pc.fail: It stays with the water off; or appears before the spray; or two rainbows appear from one spray.

pc.expect: The rainbow shows the spectrum's order in a band.
pc.fail: It is a single colour; or the colours are in random order; or it changes colours.
It rises indefinitely; or hangs; or falls upward.
A second hose appears; or the spray comes from nowhere; or the rainbow becomes solid.

pc.expect: The garden and the hose stay the same.
pc.fail: The garden rearranges; or the hose changes colour; or the sky changes abruptly.
